Pretty Fish

Fish forms and line work use fishdraw by Lingdong Huang (2021).
https://github.com/LingDong-/fishdraw
Full MIT license: fishdraw.txt

Paper, colour and stroke primitives, Perlin noise, and pigment filters are
extracted and adapted from nonflowers by Lingdong Huang (2018).
https://github.com/LingDong-/nonflowers
Full MIT license: nonflowers.txt

Both original copyright and permission notices are included in this directory.
Pretty Fish's integration and webpage are also released under the MIT license.
